meta.parties: Ranasinghe v. The Ceylon State Mortgage Bank

rules.statement: The District Court does not have the jurisdiction to review decisions of statutory tribunals, such as a bank's determination under the Ceylon State Mortgage Bank Act.
rules.supporting_quote: "If it [the District Court] does so, it would be acting in excess of its jurisdiction. When we are called upon to decide whether the District Court has jurisdiction with regard to any matter we cannot assume the power of making law for that purpose."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Ceylon State Mortgage Bank Act (Cap. 398) as amended by Act No. 33 of 1968, sections 10(B)(2)(1)(a), 70(B)(2)(l)(a), 71(2)(b).
